cues: Both are diatomic, with the same gamma and the same pressure, so the ratio of speeds is the square root of the inverse ratio of densities: root of one point two nine three over zero point zero nine, about three point eight.
Sound is nearly four times faster in hydrogen, because it is so light while just as stiff.
